about.description:
isschecker validates NetCDF output from ice sheet models against the
ISMIP7 data request conventions.  Each file is checked for naming,
numerical values and units, spatial grid extent and resolution, time
axis encoding, and required global and coordinate attributes, with
findings reported as either errors or warnings.

The compliance criteria (variable metadata, valid experiment year ranges
and durations, and grid definitions) are bundled with the package.

name: isschecker
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: isschecker
  version: "0.1.0"
  python_min: "3.11"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/ismip/ISM_SimulationChecker/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e0b9ff7178ef40799c70b0122ce5195f86c3973b2101e5e3560ded9677e4200e

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - ismip7-compliance-checker = isschecker:main
      - ismip7-generate-test-files = isschecker.generate:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools >=77
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
    - numpy >=2.1,<3
    - pandas >=2.2,<4
    - xarray >=2025.1.2,<2027
    - cftime >=1.6.4,<2
    - netcdf4 >=1.7,<2
    - tqdm >=4.66

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - isschecker
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - ismip7-compliance-checker --help
      - ismip7-generate-test-files --help

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: ISMIP7 compliance checker for ice sheet model simulation NetCDF datasets
  description: |
    isschecker validates NetCDF output from ice sheet models against the
    ISMIP7 data request conventions.  Each file is checked for naming,
    numerical values and units, spatial grid extent and resolution, time
    axis encoding, and required global and coordinate attributes, with
    findings reported as either errors or warnings.

    The compliance criteria (variable metadata, valid experiment year ranges
    and durations, and grid definitions) are bundled with the package.
  homepage: https://github.com/ismip/ISM_SimulationChecker
  repository: https://github.com/ismip/ISM_SimulationChecker

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - xylar
